YouTube Downloader.changelog:
• Complete rebranding and evolution from a simple downloader to the comprehensive DasMediaHub platform.
• Full transition to a modern Jetpack Compose UI for a more fluid and responsive user experience.
• Implemented a multi-module architecture for enhanced performance and long-term stability.
• Added multi-platform support including extraction for TikTok and Instagram content.
• Integrated an embedded Python runtime for high-accuracy metadata scraping.
• Developed a custom resumable download engine with HTTP Range support for unreliable networks.
• Added local database persistence for Watch History and Favorites management.
• Introduced Picture-in-Picture (PiP) support for multitasking.
• Enhanced storage management allowing users to define custom paths for Music and Video libraries.
• Centralized error mapping to provide clear, actionable feedback for network and processing errors.

DasMediaHub.changelog:
• Major refactoring of the video player architecture to improve lifecycle management and stability.
• Optimized video transition logic to eliminate visual flicker and ghosting when switching playback items.
• Consolidated player states into a unified reactive model for better synchronization between UI and engine.
• Improved metadata caching to provide instant UI feedback during background data fetching.
• Enhanced background media notification controls with support for favoriting videos directly from the lock screen.
• Fixed orientation handling issues to ensure seamless transitions between portrait and landscape fullscreen modes.
• Optimized dependency injection for more reliable service and repository management.
• Implemented comprehensive internal documentation and code standards across all modules.
• General performance optimizations and bug fixes for the final production release.
